findings.problem: The Big Idea skips Ephesians 2:6-7. It never mentions that God raised us up with Christ and seated us with Him in the heavenly realms, or that He did this so that in the coming ages He might display the surpassing riches of His grace. It goes straight from being made alive (Ephesians 2:4-5) to grace through faith (Ephesians 2:8-9). Ephesians 2:2-3 is also thin: walking in the ways of this world and of the ruler of the power of the air, and being by nature children of wrath, are reduced to the one word "dead."

rule.text: It covers the whole passage, including any included parable or sermon.

findings.problem: The last line ends with "And Paul's not done with this letter yet, friend." passage-info.txt gives Story group: none and Position: none, but the teaching does go on in Ephesians 2:11 ("Therefore remember..."). The docs don't say whether "the next passage" means the next verses in the Bible or the next passage in the app's lesson set, so it isn't clear whether this line belongs in a passage with no story group.
findings.question: When a passage has no story group, should the Big Idea still say the teaching continues if the next Bible verses carry it on (like Ephesians 2:11)? Or should the continuation line only be used for passages in a story group?
